summary: Stop repeated local caller ancestry diagnostics at unreadable service-manager boundaries

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

rules.detail: Unreadable same-uid systemd ancestors still produce unavailable ancestry, never person authority. Agent markers and connector/ancestor generation checks retain their existing behavior.

compatibility.detail: Linux EACCES when reading an ancestor systemd environment ends the ancestry walk quietly without changing its result. Other ancestry diagnostics are limited to one report per minute per daemon.

downtime.detail: The logging change takes effect on daemon restart; no migration is required.
